The Demolitionist Pack contains:
• The Demolitionist Uniform (Helmet, Armor, and Cape)
• MG-105 'Stalwart': A light machinegun based on the AR-19 'Liberator'. It's very powerful when used in sustained fire, but the initial recoil is often hard to handle resulting in unpredictable spread.
• REC-6 'Demolisher': A remote Explosive Charge capable of destroying both objectives and heavily armored enemies. The user can decide when to detonate the charge by pressing the detonator. Often referred to as a Satchel Charge.

The Specialist Pack contains:
• The Specialist Uniform (Helmet, Armor, and Cape)
• LAS-12 'Tanto': An ultra compact laser SMG with extremely limited range. The short focused beam is very powerful to compensate for the short engagement envelope.
• Close Air Support: An 'Eagle' delivers a powerful strafing run followed by a pair of anti tank missiles. Effective at damaging almost all targets it does however have the drawback of being slightly unpredictable.

apps.name: HELLDIVERS™ - Weapons Pack
apps.short_description:
The Weapons Pack is a collection of weapons not normally issued to Helldivers. The weapons are both ultra modern experimental weapons and tried and true workhorses in new formats. 

The Weapons Pack contains:
• PLAS-1 ‘Scorcher’: The first ever Helldiver issued plasma weapon. This primary weapon fires bolts of superheated plasma that explodes on impact. Super Earth scientists have gone to great lengths to ensure that the weapon is safe and reliable to operate, though this adds some limitations to the weapon such as lacking a full auto fire mode.
• M-25 ‘Rumbler’: The ‘Rumbler’ is a heavy portable mortar firing three round bursts of 80mm grenades. Though heavy and prone to ammunition shortage, the rumbler has the capability of firing at a variable distance, allowing the user precise control of where the shots land.
• AC-22 ‘Dum Dum’: The AC-22 is a 20mm cannon commonly found in the Helldiver arsenal, though usually mounted on vehicles. This is a shoulder carried version allowing for Helldivers on foot to carry a very powerful weapon that is excellent for taking out medium armored targets.

apps.name: Shadow Realms RPG - Frostreign Season Pass
apps.short_description: The premium track of the Frostreign season, November through January: thirty tiers a month of gold, gear, pets and the season exclusive avatars. Included with Lifetime Legend.

apps.name: Shadow Realms RPG - Lifetime Legend
apps.short_description: Legend VIP for life, paid once: +50% XP, +15% gold and item find, 8-hour auto-battle, the daily chest and every Season Pass premium track, on every character, forever.

apps.name: Shadow Realms RPG - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Back Shadow Realms at launch and wear it: the Supporter title, two extra character slots and 500 Sovereigns, granted to your account the moment the game starts. Launch-window only. Accounts hold up to 3 extra slots in total across the Supporter Pack and Slots I to III.

apps.name: Taskbar Cat - Extra Companion
apps.short_description: Welcome one more cat to your taskbar. Adopt and name an additional companion with a random coat, eyes and personality, then pet, feed and play together. A one-time pack for Taskbar Cat; this local companion cannot be traded.

apps.name: The Last Gas Station: Winter Resort
apps.short_description: Return to the old gas station years later, this time as a raccoon. Turn the snowbound backwoods into a winter resort with an ice rink, ski slopes, guided tours, and cozy cabins for your guests.

apps.name: Trainz 2022 DLC - VR C Locomotive - SSR Pack 2
apps.short_description: This pack features a selection of SSR patched livery ex Victorian Railways C class locomotives. These locomotives are packed with scripted features, high detail models and textures, and feature 4 different versions of the locomotives in various SSR special liveries.

apps.name: Trainz Plus DLC - VR C Locomotive - SSR Pack 2
apps.short_description: This pack features a selection of SSR patched livery ex Victorian Railways C class locomotives. These locomotives are packed with scripted features, high detail models and textures, and feature 4 different versions of the locomotives in various SSR special liveries.

apps.name: Tropico 4 Plantador DLC
apps.short_description: Get into the plantation business!

apps.name: World of Warships – 9 Years on Steam Pack
apps.short_description: Pick up some Steam camos, Steam patches, and a Steam flag, then sail out in celebration of World of Warships' 9th anniversary on Steam.

apps.name: wozitdev's 3D Reaper - Quest Mode
apps.short_description: The quest_mode.apk has been made a separate DLC so that it's download can be managed separately.

apps.name: 孤岛的动物园 - 第四章
apps.short_description: A remote island worships light energy as the source of all life. When that faith begins to fail, three protagonists must confront a changing world in this story-driven visual novel featuring alternative rock style original soundtracks.

apps.name: 宇宙創世記カグラ - 文明創世ラボ
apps.short_description: Use particles earned through rhythm gameplay to build civilizations, from early settlements to cities. Spin the globe, explore daily life through illustrated guides and conversations with Kagura and the gods, and play national anthems from around the world.

apps.name: 1999 Lockdown Unit
apps.short_description: Autumn 1999: A rainy night, a sudden quarantine. As a virus mutates your neighbors, barricade your apartment, survive the lockdown routine, and outlast the nightmare.

apps.name: 9999+ Weapons: Idle RPG
apps.short_description: Lead a squad of collectible companions in an open-world idle RPG shared with other players. Summon heroes, forge better equipment, and challenge bosses as your squad grows stronger. Explore new areas, take on quests, or spend some time fishing, mining, and woodcutting.

apps.name: A Story of Questions
apps.short_description: You are trapped, unable to walk, only a desk in front of you. The voice you hear is that of a woman on a speaker. Solve puzzles, interact with your surroundings, and make weighty decisions as you uncover a strange and disturbing story in this supernatural single-player horror mystery.
developers: Under the Bridge Games by Tim Hertel
publishers: Under the Bridge Games by Tim Hertel

apps.name: AD METALLUM
apps.short_description: You are the rebel. Drill, blast, and pulverize everything in your path. Fortresses crumble, walls collapse, and the world bends to your fury. Take on brutal single-player campaigns or unleash chaos in multiplayer. AD METALLUM is destruction, rebellion, and steel incarnate.

apps.name: Adonai Dwelling: Christmas
apps.short_description: Unravel the story of Jesus Christ's birth as told through eyewitness accounts. How much do you really know about the origins of Christmas?

apps.name: ADULT
apps.short_description: Match gems, cast spells and challenge 10 fantasy rivals in ADULT. Build your equipment, conquer 100 campaign levels and collect 100 illustrations in an unlockable gallery. A turn-based match-3 adventure for adults.

apps.name: AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES
apps.short_description: The tiniest adventure in the world begins! Place it anywhere on your desktop and watch your heroes battle automatically. Effortlessly enjoy a flood of loot and the thrill of progression.

apps.name: After-State:WoLong\灵界奇谈：卧龙
apps.short_description: In this surreal afterlife deduction game by CnD Games, play as Zhuge Liang—the East's legendary mastermind. Face off against Sherlock Holmes in the Underworld Olympics and unravel a deadly closed-circle mystery trapped within a snowed-in mountain lodge!

apps.name: Air Crisis
apps.short_description: Launch from the carrier into fast arcade jet combat. Fight through dozens of missions across five settings around the world, from coral coasts and farmland to deserts, frozen fjords and a harbour city. Lock on to enemy jets, dodge missiles and strike ground targets.

apps.name: ALDERIC
apps.short_description: The ash of a burned archive steals the names of lands and people. Only the nameless can walk through it. Choose your road on the Ash Map, break the wards, slay each land's lord and reclaim it before the ash spreads. A single-player action RPG with five classes, explosive skills and loot to hunt.

apps.name: Alex Hill: The Body at Clearwater Bay
apps.short_description: When a body mysteriously washes up on the shores of Clearwater Bay, you, as Detective Alex Hill, are hired to investigate. Was it a tragic suicide or is something more sinister at work? Solve puzzles, look for evidence, and confront a web of lies as you work to uncover the truth.

apps.name: Alkahestry
apps.short_description: Alkahestry is a game about equivalent exchange, where everything (including you) can be destroyed. Build your own spells and use them to destroy city walls, or turn your own body into a weapon of pure energy.

apps.name: Alura Quest
apps.short_description: A top-down action adventure in the spirit of the classic 8- and 16-bit quests: one big overworld, dungeons, caves and secrets everywhere. Unravel the mystery of the world of Gildilox and overcome the darkness that overtakes it.

apps.name: Apostle of Mustard
apps.short_description: A difficult 3d precision platformer. Hop, skip, and skid your way across an eerie purgatory. Thread though a rage inducing gauntlet of platforms while unraveling a mustard flavored mystery. Will you make it home, or will you be stuck forever?

apps.name: ASAGE
apps.short_description: A short hand-drawn adventure set in a serene blue-green forest. The only thing you can do on the world map is pray. Meet the forest's residents and complete a traditional Japanese breakfast known as Asage through a series of charming, slightly strange minigames.

apps.name: Autonomous Anarchy
apps.short_description: A retro twin-stick bullet-hell where you fight hordes of enemies, collect powerful weapons and upgrades, and go head to head with menacing mechanical bosses. Take on the hordes solo or with a friend in local co-op!

apps.name: Backpack of Wishes
apps.short_description: The apocalypse changed everything: every man but you turned into a monster. The women of this world are going crazy with a THIRST that ONLY YOU can satisfy 😏🔥 Bring GIRLS back to your shelter, tear them from the bosses' grasp, and decide who you will put through her paces all night long. 🍆💦

apps.name: Baggage Bedlam
apps.short_description: Baggage Bedlam is a fast paced multiplayer party game where friends compete to route luggage through chaotic airport conveyor belts. Flip switches, grab power ups, dodge floor hazards, and sabotage your friends as you race to deliver bags to the right destinations!

apps.name: Balloons Inc.
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op balloon factory game. Blow up and tie balloons by hand, build automated production lines, research new tech and pop-test your stock on the range, then expand into bouncy castles, hot air balloons and a trip to the edge of space. Solo or with up to 3 friends!

apps.name: Barren bargain
apps.short_description: Manage your farm, interact with visitors, and decide who is worthy of your help during these difficult times for the kingdom.

apps.name: Benson Bones
apps.short_description: A top-down pixel art action RPG. You wake in a graveyard, a dog finds you, and then a portal takes him. Learn every enemy's tell, take down bosses that punish button-mashing, and cross hand-built realms to bring him home.

apps.name: BLACKSITE SHIFT
apps.short_description: A first-person sci-fi horror game for solo play or online co-op with up to four players. Memorize the rooms of an underground facility, spot changes, and report anomalies. Survive seven night shifts—some anomalies can kill you.

apps.name: Bless Global
apps.short_description: BLESS GLOBAL is a medieval fantasy MMO featuring immersive aesthetics, which depicts a live magical world through grand stories and console-level graphics. The game offers solid battle animation and unfettered mobile combat, bringing an immersive and epic gaming experience to every players!

apps.name: Blind Phobia
apps.short_description: You are blind and trapped in an infinite hospital corridor. Use your guide cane and other senses to detect anomalies, question illusions, and find a way out.

apps.name: Blobby Bash
apps.short_description: BOUNCE, BATTLE AND BASH your friends in this fast paced movement party game! Engage in 7 different game modes where winning requires speed, strategy and skill! Customise your Bert with unlockable outfits galore!

apps.name: Blok Stock and Barrel
apps.short_description: An experimental weapons range for game night. Punch holes through walls, drive anything with wheels, and settle scores with energy rifles, sticky bombs and the occasional shovel. Not a competitive shooter, just good dumb fun with your friends. Nothing to see here.

apps.name: Bobls
apps.short_description: Bobls is a tight precision platformer with hundreds of handcrafted levels, a dedicated co-op campaign, endless community-made challenges, and a powerful level editor. Blow and bounce on bubbles to build speed, chain combos, and chase that perfect run.

apps.name: Brad Dracula
apps.short_description: A wobbly physics game at a vampire accountant's house. That's me. I'm Brad. Come alone, or bring a friend to your couch, and steal the fruit of immortality off my tree. Behind my doors are seven worlds, and there's a whole 16-bit RPG on my TV. Stay off the lawn. ...Have a great day.

apps.name: Brass & Brine
apps.short_description: Command a steam-driven ironclad across three legs of hostile sea. Fit your guns, take a refit after every wave, chart your route and sink the bosses that rule each ocean, alone or with up to four captains online or in split-screen co-op.

apps.name: Brokie
apps.short_description: You went all in with borrowed money and lost everything. Start over with $2,000 in a share house: work part-time jobs, gather clues from news, rumors and store shelves, trade 18 fictional stocks and keep your stress in check. How far can you climb in one year?

apps.name: Caladrius2 - Dark Element
apps.short_description:
A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness...
Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. 
Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

apps.name: Campfire Harmony
apps.short_description: A little fox camps on your desktop and works while you work. Your keys and clicks keep it fetching firewood and roasting marshmallows for Stars, and every Star grows your camp. Take a break and it naps. Pet the fox, skip stones, and invite two friends to the fire.

apps.name: Candle Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own cozy candle shop. Choose waxes and fragrances, pour candles, plan your batches and welcome customers. Blend signature scents, decorate your space and take your handmade collection to market as your little business grows.

apps.name: Carbon Sabre - Revolutions Per Millenium
apps.short_description:
In a feudal land, a band of strangers embark on a journey to defeat the corrupt corporation bearing down on their lives.
Take back control in snappy turn based combat by managing your party and building up Beat to perform devastating combos!

apps.name: Card Sim: Chinese Restaurant
apps.short_description: Welcome to Card Simulator: Chinese Restaurant! Every dish begins with a card. Drag and combine ingredient cards to craft authentic Chinese cuisine. Earn coins, unlock new recipes, expand and decorate your restaurant, and build a must-visit foodie hotspot. Start your chef journey today!

apps.name: Cat Tower
apps.short_description: In this turn-based RPG, follow the story of a woman fighting off a terrible curse in order to save a loved one. Discover spells, choose talents, adjust attributes, recruit powerful allies, and reset your build to explore new strategies in order survive the treacherous world ahead.

apps.name: Catnip Wars : Labyrinth
apps.short_description: Drop into a Necronazi labyrinth with up to three friends, or a squad of Catbot companions. Your weapons fire on their own: you steer, dodge and pick upgrades. Fight to the stairs at the centre of every floor, twenty floors down, before the Oberst comes for you. Then keep going.

apps.name: Catonium - out of chaos
apps.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of Catonium, a medieval fantasy world on the brink of chaos. In the wake of "The Fall," a cataclysmic event that shattered the realm a decade ago. Ancient ruins, cities, and vast landscapes await your exploration. Forge your path, uncover secrets, and shape the future.

apps.name: Cave Saga
apps.short_description: Explore the caves in this action-adventure platformer. Jump, dash, pick up, and throw objects or creatures to help escape the various complex cave systems. Each biome you explore contains unique mechanics and aesthetics. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op!

apps.name: CFS 3
apps.short_description: You are F, fighting to survive a F-less world controlled by the cows and strong foes like the betrayer. Recover your body and meld yourself back together and stop the rising nation that once wiped your people... (STEAM EDITION)

apps.name: ChemLab
apps.short_description: Mix substances, heat them, separate them, and experiment freely. ChemLab is a 2D chemistry sandbox based on real chemistry, where you can combine substances, change temperature and experimental conditions, and discover new reactions and materials through hands-on experimentation.

apps.name: Chessboxing Arcade
apps.short_description: Chess Boxing Arcade is a 2D arcade take on the real sport: alternate between timed chess rounds and fast-paced boxing rounds. Win by checkmate, knockout or the clock against adaptive AI, friends locally, or opponents online.

apps.name: Chihuahua Racing
apps.short_description: Arcade combat racing on planet Chihuahua! Twenty dogs race for the championship across 20 tracks with homing missiles, bombs, 18 wild supers and 26 random events. Build your own tracks, then race them alone or split screen with a friend, even tied together by a rope.

apps.name: Cityterium
apps.short_description: Cityterium is a multiplayer voxel sandbox where the real world becomes your canvas. Choose a city, build freely, tear things down, and reshape it with others, one block at a time.

apps.name: Civilization Idle
apps.short_description: A strategy-driven idle game where you develop your civilization, research technologies, and make critical decisions to expand your empire across the ages.

apps.name: Click Dystopia
apps.short_description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

apps.name: Click the Stone: Active Incremental and Idler
apps.short_description: Click the Stone is an incremental game about clicking a stone to receive rocks and coins that deliver incredible rewards. Build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your tribespeople join the fun. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

apps.name: Clown Around
apps.short_description: You are a clown! Clown Around is an immersive sim FPS where your job is to explore large open levels to identify and prank targets working to rid the world of fun. Choose your loadout from an arsenal of wacky clown tools and insane perks that wildly change your playstyle. How you play is up to you!

apps.name: Cook Cook Village ~!
apps.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

apps.name: Cooking Adventure
apps.short_description: Cook, serve, and upgrade your way through a fast-paced 2D time management cooking game rebuilt for PC. Master recipes, manage busy stations, satisfy quirky customers, and chase high scores across colorful restaurants.

apps.name: Cordonfall
apps.short_description: Type in your address and defend your own street. Cordonfall turns any real neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap into a zombie siege: make a building your HQ, put soldiers on the rooftops, fortify by day, and hold out for ten nights as the horde grows every dusk.

apps.name: COTTON
apps.short_description: A cozy isometric sim about running a 1980s cotton farm out bush. Pump the water, plant and chip the paddocks, fly the duster and get the pickers in. Play the manager, or borrow the soul of anyone on the place, from the mechanic to the school bus driver. Ride out the floods and beat the bell.

apps.name: Cozy Trails
apps.short_description: Paint winding trails through a nature park, line them with trees, benches and lookouts, and watch hikers and their pets wander, admire the views and grumble about the loos. A cozy park-builder where every star is earned by making a walk people love.

apps.name: Crafted Legends
apps.short_description: Build awesome racing tracks, challenge other players' ghosts, and discover what happens when realistic physics meets questionable driving skills. Create, race, crash, repeat. Roads are optional. Gravity isn't. Welcome to Crafted Legends, where even your worst ideas deserve a test drive.

apps.name: Creeper World 5
apps.short_description: Fight a relentless fluid enemy in this mix of tower defense and real-time strategy. Build your base, grow your forces, and unleash massive firepower to reclaim vast flooded worlds. Face Creeper types with different physics, deploy experimental technology, and create your own maps and units.

apps.name: Crossroads: Ancient Sagas
apps.short_description: Experience Crossroads: Ancient Sagas, where every turn is a new chapter. Master the art of tactical deployment and cunning maneuvers. Vibrant colors and diverse deck compositions ensure no two games are alike.

apps.name: CRUCIBLE OF THE ABYSS
apps.short_description: Slot, fuse, and discover. A dark fantasy first-person dungeon crawler where you build every action from parts, melt them together into new powers, and descend fifty floors into the abyss.

apps.name: Crusader: No Regret™
apps.short_description: You’re a renegade Silencer out to settle a score with the powerful World Economic Consortium. Only your instincts, agility and firepower can get you in one piece to the ultimate confrontation with your greatest enemy.

apps.name: Cycho
apps.short_description: Betray your friends in this chaotic 6-player dice-driven online board game of strategy, trust, and treachery. Manipulate a dynamic economy, build your business empire, and master unique character skills to  be the last team standing. In Cycho, alliances are fragile, and friendships are fleeting.

apps.name: Dark Gothic Doll Party
apps.short_description: Before her mainspring stops, a wind-up doll girl climbs a gothic clock-tower theatre to meet its master. A bullet-hell shooter across five acts and an extra stage: gather screws to buy time, face six doll bosses, and reach one of four endings that change with difficulty. Relief Mode included.

apps.name: DEBTBOUND: Never Unplug
apps.short_description: DEBTBOUND: Never Unplug is a FPS roguelite where you’ll fight waves of enemies while building your upgrade deck, discovering new items, and exploring procedurally generated maps. Your weapon can also mutate into different combat styles.

apps.name: Dig n Fight
apps.short_description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

apps.name: DineInn
apps.short_description: DineInn is a cozy horror restoration sim where you clean, repair, cook, farm, explore, and manage a forgotten diner and inn to restore it for profit. Uncover its buried secrets while maintaining your sanity, or the horror will begin. (Single dev project)

apps.name: Don't Drop The Ball
apps.short_description: Don't Drop the Ball is a 1-4 player co-op game about keeping a beach ball in the air as you race through checkpoints together. Punch the ball, make desperate saves, and whack your friends when they get in the way. Race the clock, climb the leaderboard, and remember, DON'T. DROP. THE. BALL.

apps.name: Don't Mind Liam
apps.short_description: Seeking to make some easy money, a high school senior decides to babysit a strange little boy... with an even stranger imaginary friend.

apps.name: Dread of the Deep
apps.short_description: Aim your beam, fire, and choose which side to leave in the dark. Fight overwhelming hordes and combine weapons into powerful builds. Shape your lighthouse with a sprawling talent tree, and uncover what waits beneath the waves.

apps.name: DriftBorne
apps.short_description: A choice-driven adult visual novel where you play as an immortal navigating romance, betrayal, supernatural mysteries, and meaningful relationships shaped by every decision you make.

apps.name: Duck Tape & Prayers
apps.short_description: Your ship is falling apart and home is 35 sectors away. Grab your crew, an extinguisher and a lot of duct tape: put out fires, patch hull breaches and fix short circuits in chaotic co-op for 1 to 4 players, on the couch or online.

apps.name: Dummy Lab
apps.short_description: Crash Dummies have gone rogue! Saw them apart, harvest scrap, upgrade your Saw, deploy defensive devices, and stop an evil CEO’s horde from escaping the Testing Chamber in this satisfying incremental game.

apps.name: DUST & DEBT
apps.short_description: Framed for a debt of one billion in a ruined world. Explore 10 km × 10 km of Ashfall and shape your build with over 2,500 gear designs and branching skills. Find a loyal canine companion, uncover the truth behind the debt, and confront the man who took your freedom.

apps.name: Dynasty Bowl
apps.short_description: Dynasty Bowl combines retro 2D football with the team building of dynasty fantasy football. Pick your play and take it to the house, challenge a friend on your couch, or build your very own dynasty. Draft rookies, trade players, and chase championships season after season.

apps.name: Earth Legends
apps.short_description: A physics-driven football adventure where every touch, pass, and strike is yours to control. Experience true freedom with your friends on the pitch – pure football shaped by skill, rivalry, and friendship.

apps.name: Eldon Desktop Buddy
apps.short_description: A free desktop buddy with 13 characters from Eldon the Unemployed. Click them, drag them around and let them interrupt your day. Play pinball, PeeBitties Mania and the online text adventure Legend of the Red Droar. Human voice actors, original music and plenty of bad company.

apps.name: Eldritch Survivors
apps.short_description:
Eldritch Survivors is a Lovecraftian roguelite where you kill swarms of enemies, gain insight to the Mythos, and unlock otherworldly powers.

Can you survive long enough to stop The Cosmic Conspiracy’s nefarious plans?

apps.name: Elemental Wandering Survivors
apps.short_description:
Face hordes of corrupted creatures in challenging lands with the help of magical abilities.

Elemental Wandering Survivors is a horde survival game where your goal is to persevere in combat against monsters while evolving your battle potential to explore hostile lands.

apps.name: Emery Hearts
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.

apps.name: Empty Box
apps.short_description: You are a reporter in a city of animals shrouded in fog and lies. A mysterious murder uncovers a web of secrets. Investigate crime scenes, question witnesses, verify evidence, and decide what deserves to be published. Everyone has their version of the story. This time, you're holding the pen.

apps.name: Escape from Doomstown
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game where you lead a squad of survivors into a zombie-infested town. Scavenge for supplies, take down dangerous foes, and get out before the horde closes in. Build your base, recruit survivors, strengthen your squad, and fight your way out of this doomed city!

apps.name: Escape to Ariah
apps.short_description: Master deep skill trees, forge god-tier gear, and carve through relentless hordes in this dark fantasy ARPG. Endless build variety, thrilling boss fights, and endgame adventures await you.

apps.name: Evades X
apps.short_description: Evade your way through danger with friends in the World's Hardest Precision Game!

apps.name: Everise
apps.short_description:
Reach the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town.
Scavenge the furniture and loot monsters to collect resources along the way, then empty your inventory down balconies to upgrade and defend your town!

apps.name: Everpixel
apps.short_description: Everpixel is what happens when you combine tactical RPG, pixels, and wiener dogs. Lead your motley crew to pixelated dominance--or die trying.

apps.name: Excised
apps.short_description: Excised is an action thriller game where you must escape a fantastical dystopia by using combat, stealth, powers, and immersive exploits against stalker-like enemies, in order to unravel the mystery, and decide the fate of the metropolis.

apps.name: Fable
apps.short_description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

apps.name: Fairy Ranch
apps.short_description: Fairy Ranch is a fast-paced multiplayer co-op management simulation game. Players engage in a variety of production activities across diverse biomes—including grasslands, forests, deserts, mountains, and snowy plains—gathering products to complete orders.

apps.name: Fat Cat Cruz
apps.short_description: Free-to-play third-person robot action with RTS elements. Pilot giant machines, command allies, and fight 1v5, 2v5, or five-way free-for-all battles across 11 maps. Robots are sold separately. Online multiplayer and cross-platform play are coming soon. Out December 21, 2026.

apps.name: Fenimore Fillmore Trilogy
apps.short_description: One cowboy. Three wild adventures. Join Fenimore Fillmore in 3 Skulls of the Toltecs, The Westerner and Revenge: a collection of point-and-click mysteries, inventive puzzles and frontier humour.

apps.name: Fishlings: A Cozy Fish Collector
apps.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium where every fish comes out of a card pack. Rip packs, flip cards, chase the 1-in-1,000 Prismatic and collect 80+ odd little fish in four variants. Your tank keeps growing and earning while you're away, or swims in a tiny window on your desktop while you work.

apps.name: Forge & Fleet
apps.short_description: Forge gear, recruit your crew and build a powerful ship in this idle naval Rpg. Battle enemy ships and bosses, earn resources while away, and refine your build. Join a Fleet for shared challenges or compete in asynchronous Pvp leagues.

apps.name: Frost Kin
apps.short_description:
FROST KIN is an Arctic Survival Tragedy: Armed with only a spear and the lingering soul of your twin brother, you must bind his spirit to wild and ancient beings to survive. But life is fleeting — every transfer chips away at his humanity. 

This is not an open world. This is a closing wound.

apps.name: Frostrail
apps.short_description: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

apps.name: Futa World: Flesh Farm of Futanari Dairy Cows
apps.short_description: In a near-future Tokyo, a third sex has emerged—the Futanari. Blessed with lush feminine curves yet burdened with a monstrous phallus, they are insatiable beasts of lust who exist only to breed.

apps.name: Futa World: When the Innocent Streamer Goes Offline
apps.short_description: By day, Kagurazaka Kanade is a beloved "healing" streamer, whispering sweet words to hundreds of thousands of fans. By night, she is a masturbation-addicted beast, cumming a liter at a time against her open window.

apps.name: Gamercury World Engine
apps.short_description: Turn one idea into a playable AI world. Gamercury World Engine helps creators build detective mysteries, dress-up dramas, simulation games, and cinematic interactive stories with AI-generated plots, quests, character dialogue, voice, cutscenes, and 3D scenes.

apps.name: Garden Cleaner: Cozy Grass Simulator
apps.short_description: 200,000+ blades of grass. Two bare hands. Pull them one by one, sell the harvest, and work your way up to a riding mower in a calm, cozy first-person yard cleaning game.

apps.name: Garden of Ants
apps.short_description: Become the architect of a thriving ant colony in this real-time simulation. Establish and evolve your ant colony, grow  specialized worker castes, cultivate fungus, and explore a living world above and below ground where day and night bring shifting challenges and resources.

apps.name: GBald
apps.short_description: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.

apps.name: Gently Packed
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of a cashier in Gently Packed, a relaxing store management game where you scan, pack, and serve customers with care. Upgrade your shop, run promotions, meet corporate goals, and pay off your franchise loan.

apps.name: Geritmia
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you mine, fight and grow stronger while the World Eater devours everything behind you faster and faster.

apps.name: GHOSTGRID
apps.short_description: Take freelance hacking jobs in a port city. Break into fictional networks with real commands, investigate breaches, write the report, then go out and pay the rent. Everything you do leaves a record, and investigators read them. 153 real techniques, and the game checks that you did them.

apps.name: Globul
apps.short_description: A geography quiz and puzzle game. Assemble flags from their pieces, find a country on a blank map, link neighbours together or find the shortest route between two capitals, and more.

apps.name: GNOMINAL
apps.short_description: $50,000 in debt. Clock in each night and shoot garden gnomes for the cash inside, but every bullet is billed to your balance. When the horn sounds, clock out with your takings, or stay for overtime—bigger payouts, bigger losses.

apps.name: God's League
apps.short_description: God's League is a next-gen Action RPG by a solo indie dev, featuring dynamic combat, diverse weapons, armor, heroes, and magic. Infused with Bible verses, it inspires players to grow spiritually and walk in the path of Jesus.

apps.name: Granule
apps.short_description:
A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. 
Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

apps.name: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms
apps.short_description: Greak 2 is a hand-drawn co-op metroidvania adventure. After fleeing their invaded world, siblings Greak and Adara find themselves in the hostile lands of Synoraz. Split in parallel dimensions, they must work together to save the last Storm egg before the ancient species is lost forever

apps.name: Harvest Mana
apps.short_description: Harvest Mana plays like a combination of Hades and Stardew Valley. Explore the Roguelite dungeon to acquire resources that can be used to upgrade your farm and the nearby village.

apps.name: HAUL AFTER DARK
apps.short_description: A mansion recovery horror game in development with co-op as its focus and solo expeditions also supported. Choose a contract, haul valuables to the van, and decide when to escape. Co-op is in development and is not yet verified in the current build.

apps.name: HauntedHouseNO14
apps.short_description: Burdened by debt, you move into an eerie villa, forced to survive for seven days. When night comes, all kinds of uncanny anomalies emerge. Stay alert, track every shift, find what feels wrong, and reveal the horrifying truth hidden in the villa.

apps.name: Heart Forth, Alicia
apps.short_description: A terror in the sky is bent on exterminating a young wizard and her loved ones. Featuring a riveting and sinister story, set out to explore a vast world in this modern Metroidvania RPG, filled with devious monsters, lethal dungeons, creative puzzles, lively towns & many uncharted wonders.

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Beneath Sensei's Black Stockings
apps.short_description: One evening, a private tutor sent by your mother arrives at your door. Her name is Saeki Misaki. From that first night, not a single textbook is ever opened — because her "lessons" will teach you something far more indulgent.

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Getting Fucked By A Bratty Slut
apps.short_description:
You are a burned-out office worker, numb from endless overtime. One day, 
your childhood neighbor — a smug, twin-tailed girl named Rin — starts barging into your room every night, 
claiming she's here to "take care of you."

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Neko Addiction - Please Adopt Me Too Senpai
apps.short_description: Exhausted from work, you rescue a stray cat in the rain— and somehow, so does your clingy junior from the office, Himari. Before you know it, she's living in your apartment, caring for the cat... and for you.

apps.name: Here Comes the Horde
apps.short_description: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

apps.name: Hide and Freak
apps.short_description: A goofy online ghost hunt, a seeker with a magic lantern, and a whole room of ghosts hiding in plain sight, posing, dancing and sneaking up behind you. Rainy graveyard, PS1 look, up to 16 players with room codes.

apps.name: HIGH HORNS
apps.short_description: CLIMB TO CONQUER! Physics-based co-op VR climbing

apps.name: Hollow Winter
apps.short_description: The war is over. The winter is not. Years after a global conflict, the dangers that surround you in the north are not zombies or looters. It's the cold, the ashes, the wolves and the fire you manage to light. Keep it burning.

apps.name: Hurtle Turtle
apps.short_description: "WHERE THE SHELL IS MY WIFE?!? I need to find her!" Hurtle your way across the world to regain lost love before running out of energy and try to stay on course!

apps.name: I Shall Seek Immortality
apps.short_description: A cozy idle cultivation game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Travel, loot, survive heavenly tribulations, slay your inner demon and seize a sect throne. Stealth mode and a boss key for work; duels, leaderboards and tradable treasures on Steam.

apps.name: Idle Isekai - An idle RPG
apps.short_description: Idle Isekai is a strategic idle RPG with roguelite elements designed for players who love managing complex growth systems. Whether you are battling fearsome monsters or meticulously managing your character's progression, the path to power is yours to define.

apps.name: Imago.Zero
apps.short_description: This is a fan-made InaSure visual novel inspired by ALDNOAH.ZERO.

apps.name: Infinite Bookshelf
apps.short_description: Sort colorful books and watch flowers bloom in this cozy 3D puzzle game. Drag books into matching shelf compartments, use your tray to plan each move, and bring order to a tropical library with procedurally generated layouts.

apps.name: Inspectory
apps.short_description: Inspect and separate the original retros from the fakes, automate the process and optimize until you cozily lift your feet up and watch the factory hum on its own.

apps.name: Iron & Instinct
apps.short_description: Raid dungeons, collect monster eggs, and hatch your own army. As the Break Knight, raise your monsters on the ranch, pick your strongest for your party, and fight side by side through ever more dangerous dungeons in this 2D monster-raising RPG.

apps.name: Kapih: An Unsung Hero
apps.short_description: Run, jump and blast through a colorful vision of ancient India in Kapih, a classic run-and-gun platformer inspired by Indian art and music. Take on action-packed levels and boss battles, solo or with a friend in two-player local co-op.

apps.name: Kazu the Cassowary
apps.short_description: Run, leap and claw-kick through an Australian-inspired world in this colorful single-player 3D platforming adventure. Help Kazu rescue his captured parents, explore varied landscapes and discover secrets along the way.

apps.name: KER
apps.short_description: KER is a 2D puzzle strategy heist game where you play as Agent Orange, who have to enter into most secure building and get the FILE securely. The building is equipped with pass cords and other securities measure, but only aim to get out the file securely.

apps.name: Keycap: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: A cozy organizing game where you tidy up a keyboard shop. Sort over 4,000 keycaps, snap them into place and enjoy the satisfying click of every key. Unlock abilities, organize at your own pace and even design your own keyboards!

apps.name: Kingsbane
apps.short_description: Raid gothic fortresses in a 2D action-platformer RPG. Choose from heroes with distinct fighting styles, hunt for rare gear, and defeat the infernal kings. Replay stages to try new routes and builds. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in local or online co-op.

apps.name: Last Skull
apps.short_description: Take a ship into hostile waters, plunder islands, wrecks and rival captains, then make it out before your time runs out. Whatever you bring home is yours to keep. Sink, and what you carried is left floating for someone else.

apps.name: Leet Racer
apps.short_description: Knockout racing where every rival is a target. Ram opponents into walls, drop mines, fire homing rockets and drift for nitro on neon city tracks and shrinking-zone arenas. Tune your car until every upgrade hits harder.

apps.name: Little Tree Kingdom
apps.short_description: Build a gnome kingdom among the branches of a giant tree in this relaxing mix of city-building and roguelike deckbuilding. Grow the tree, build structures, earn cards and blessings, and survive monsters and disasters. Each run spans seasons and unfolds differently. Can your tree kingdom thrive?

apps.name: Lord of the Mountain
apps.short_description: Lead your dwarven clan back into the mountain the dragons took. Build a stronghold in the dark and filter the spore-filled air to claim ground. Then hold the line as the dragon sends its fungus-infected hordes against you. A dwarven survival RTS with pause.

apps.name: Lords, Land & Levy
apps.short_description: Build a living medieval village, defend its walls in real time, then march out to lead the assault yourself. Marry, scheme and make war across a realm of rival lords, rise from village lord to king, and hold the west against the Great Khan.

apps.name: Lost In Socks
apps.short_description: Socks are EVERYWHERE! Sort through mountains of laundry, find matching pairs, and build the ultimate Grand Sock Archive. Play at your own pace or team up with friends to tackle the chaos. Can you pair them all?

apps.name: Love Trap
apps.short_description: A suspenseful, atmospheric text adventure where you play an entrepreneur reborn two years before his mysterious death. At the scene were his abandoned ex, devoted roommate, and hostile socialite. Your choices reveal why they were there, why he died, and which truths stay buried.

apps.name: Lucky Sip
apps.short_description: This is a time-management restaurant simulation game with roguelike elements. Master a wide range of tasty drinks, meet all kinds of customers, and learn diverse management skills. Combine your options wisely to conquer both casual stage runs and the rent challenge!

apps.name: LumberBoy
apps.short_description: A woodcutting incremental where you explore different forests, process wood, and keep growing. Start with just a basic axe, max out your stats, and become the greatest lumberjack in the forest!

apps.name: MAGICA☆REVERSI!
apps.short_description: Reversi, but magical girls fire rocket launchers. Shuffle the board, flip every disc, warp in for a one-hit win. Fall behind and your comeback magic charges up. Lose the disc your character stands on and you lose on the spot. Every disc you're ahead is in-game prize money. 50 3D boards.

apps.name: Majority
apps.short_description: Govern a country in Majority, a turn-based political and economic simulation. Change laws, allocate the budget, and pursue reforms. Follow how your decisions reshape the economy and people's lives as you work to win another term in office.

apps.name: Make It Cozy
apps.short_description: Turn awkward spaces into welcoming homes in this relaxing interior design game inspired by Feng Shui. Arrange furniture, complete client orders, and unlock My Home — draw your own floor plan and furnish it your way.

apps.name: Mana Valley
apps.short_description: The witches of Mana Valley have fled to Havenfall. As a novice witch, you farm, build, brew, and refine your magic alongside a fractured coven looking for hope.

apps.name: Mecha Mayhem
apps.short_description: Rip your enemies limb from limb and rule the battlefield with a mech built entirely your way. Mix and match body parts and attachments, each with its own unique ability, across solo/co-op Campaign, competitive Multiplayer, and Freeplay. Cause chaos in this physics-based mech fighter!

apps.name: Medieval Adventure
apps.short_description: Build a medieval settlement into a thriving regional power. Manage villagers, production, seasons and trade; explore a living world, establish resource outposts, forge alliances, and defend your people from bandits and hardship.

apps.name: Metlivi Adventure
apps.short_description: Metlivi Adventure is a private narrative adventure for 1–4 players. Create a character, choose your own theme or a Story Seed, and write actions that shape an illustrated story. Play solo or with friends, then revisit your journey as a storybook.

apps.name: Mini Golf Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Build a mini golf course hole by hole, then run the shop that pays for it. Lay carpet, bend rails, add a windmill, serve customers and read their reviews. Order stock, hire staff and grow from a back yard and $500 into a full eighteen. Then step onto your own course and play.

apps.name: MonMon High
apps.short_description: In Monmon High, your choices can lead to romance, secrets, and very different paths. Meet unique girls, follow strange clues, and uncover what lies behind the events at the school... including who might be hiding a deadly secret.

apps.name: MWL Clash
apps.short_description: Step into the world of MWL Clash, a wrestling card battle game where you collect wrestlers, build powerful decks, compete in strategic matches, form factions, and rise through the rankings. Experience Story Mode, championship rivalries, and the road to becoming an MWL legend!

apps.name: My Cat Simulator
apps.short_description: The ultimate cozy pet simulator for PC and VR! Adopt, raise, and bond with your dream cat in a relaxing, customizable home. Experience lifelike, physics-based interactions using intuitive mouse and keyboard controls or fully immersive VR hands. Your perfect virtual companion awaits!

apps.name: My Stupid Friend
apps.short_description: A gay dating sim combining old-school map/HP dating systems with visual novel stories. Summerdust is never short of muscular guys. Some are cute, some are ridiculous. Who will you date?

apps.name: Mycelium Protocol
apps.short_description: A nonlinear thriller where cyberpunk meets biopunk. A rebellion is brewing in the “perfect” city of Kudesh. Choose your side and decide who you are willing to trust with your life.

apps.name: NebulArena
apps.short_description: Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!

apps.name: Neverwake
apps.short_description: You won't survive your first adventure. Probably not your second, either. Explore a retro pixel art fantasy world, fight monsters in turn-based battles, collect loot, and unlock permanent RPG upgrades. Die, learn, grow stronger, and push further with every new run.

apps.name: No Card Feelings
apps.short_description: A game.

apps.name: Nobody Suspects the Cat
apps.short_description: She took you in from the gutter. Her greedy family poisoned her tea. Now you're a fluffy house cat with a to-do list: knock things off shelves, steal a sandwich, roll over for belly rubs — and arrange tragic accidents for every heir. After all, nobody suspects the cat.

apps.name: Now Sweeping
apps.short_description: Now Sweeping is a first-person cleaning game set in a movie theatre. Pick up popcorn, wipe up spills and get paid before the next crowd walks in. Whatever you miss piles up. Buy better tools, return lost items to pick cards that change the rules, and get the whole theatre 100% clean to win.

apps.name: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
apps.short_description: Defeat, choose, grow, and break the battlefield. A Japanese dark fantasy survivor-style roguelite where you Limit Break 14 skills and cut down hordes of yokai. Defeat bosses, forge gear from their rewards, and face even stronger foes.

apps.name: One Card
apps.short_description: One Card utilises a single action card with 4 skills on each side, and a navigation mechanic to move around on the card. This is both your navigator and soldier, weapon and shield. As the game progresses, you can gain upgradable stickers to modify the way your card works.

apps.name: One Million Gallons
apps.short_description: Drain the ocean one bucket at a time. Scoop up water, sell it, and spend your cash on bigger buckets, a wheelbarrow, a golf cart, pumps and a crew of hard-working seagulls until the sea floor is bone dry and only the plug is left to pull.

apps.name: One Tiny Delivery
apps.short_description:
A exploration game about delivering packages.
Deliver various stuff to  people residing on an island using one small three-wheeled truck. 
Explore the island and drive to the peak of the mountain to deliver one final package.
Hear people's stories and take in the view around you as you drive along.

apps.name: One Twisted Boxing Day
apps.short_description: Build a manic gift-making factory as you buy upgrades, race the clock, chase quotas, fight off inspectors, and gently... unalive your employees in this comedic Christmas-themed real-time automation game. For the good of the company!

apps.name: Open Hangar
apps.short_description: Open Hangar is a rocket building and spaceflight sim. Plan, build, and fly. Unlock parts on a tech tree, design satellites, and run science experiments in orbit. Real world physics at astronomical scale. Career starts in 1957.

apps.name: OVERDRIVE PINBALL
apps.short_description: Neon pinball meets incremental progression. Earn coins, upgrade the table, and automate your launchers and flippers. Combine 120 skills to unleash multiball, chain lightning, and fever-fueled score explosions. Prestige for permanent upgrades and awaken OVERDRIVE!

apps.name: OVERSIGHT: Anomaly
apps.short_description: Gaia-7 is trapped in an unknown quantum nebula. Through its CCTV network, you must detect anomalies and decide whom to trust. A sci-fi horror interactive movie with photorealistic visuals, where observation gameplay and your choices shape the story.

apps.name: OverWorked: Santa's Workshop
apps.short_description: Build, automate and expand Santa's workshop in a chaotic 1–4 player Christmas factory builder. Construct production lines, manage your elves and manufacture BILLIONS of presents to meet an impossible Christmas quota. Keep the elves happy, or start hiring replacements.

apps.name: Panda Gambler
apps.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

apps.name: PANE OS
apps.short_description: A roguelite inside a parody of a 2000s office computer. Wire up automated boards to clear contracts, keep a failing machine alive, and earn your programs one at a time, while the toys on the desktop pull you back to the family PC you grew up on.

apps.name: Panic Operator
apps.short_description: Flick weapons into your backpack and face the hordes in this action roguelite! Manage automatic attacks, swap overheated weapons, and merge gear. Arrange skill pieces before each run and spend earned gold on permanent upgrades. Build your own way to fight!

apps.name: Perfect Ninja Painter 2
apps.short_description: This ninja master is back in action in the second installment of this fast-paced, vibrant puzzle-platformer - and this time, he’s brought a friend along.

apps.name: Perfect Ninja Painter 4
apps.short_description: Slide, paint, and outsmart every level in this new installment of a vibrant ninja-themed puzzle-platformer!

apps.name: Phantom Shapes
apps.short_description: A funny online hide-and-seek horror game for 2 to 7 players. One of you is the Phantom and hides a cursed shape on the map. The others work the night shift with flashlights, a Scanner and Ghost Salt, and must find it before time runs out or the Phantom catches them all. No microtransactions.

apps.name: Pick All the Cotton!
apps.short_description: A satisfying cotton-picking game. Pick cotton, upgrade your tools, and clear the entire cotton field.

apps.name: Pixel Card Clash
apps.short_description: The classic top-trumps duel as a retro pixel game: pick a stat, compare – CLASH! 288 cards in nine worlds, four rivals with big mouths, jokers, a card thief, a tournament with perks and a fresh duel every day. Free to play, offline and ad-free.

apps.name: Planet Chess
apps.short_description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

apps.name: Please, let me fish.
apps.short_description: All you want is to fish, but the Tide has other plans. Hold off endless swarms of cute monsters on tiny planets, collect 60 Devices, fuse them into Overclocks, and grow strong enough to face the Tide Lords! Then maybe you’ll cast your line again...

apps.name: Pocket Dynasty
apps.short_description: Coach an American football team in modern-retro pixel art. Call every play, hand the headset to your coordinators, or take the snap yourself. Draft rookies, bring legends back as coaches, chase a title, and challenge a friend on one PC or online.

apps.name: Poker Warrior
apps.short_description: This is a roguelike deck-builder game around poker suits. Hearts fuel survival, Spades drive strength, Diamonds power wealth, and Clubs embrace chaos. Through deck construction and card fusion, you can twist the suits, break expectations, and uncover wildly different builds.

apps.name: Princess Bakery
apps.short_description: Slay bakery monsters, gather ingredients, and run your bakery to grow stronger. Reclaim the title of the greatest bakery in the land, stolen by the Bakeromancer, in this roguelite action bakery-management RPG!

apps.name: Project Melvin
apps.short_description: Project Melvin is a story driven 3rd person adventure game with main story quests and side quests to get excited about. Discover story lines you never thought were possible and humour you never wanted but got.

apps.name: Puzzlozenge
apps.short_description: Rotate groups of three diamond-shaped tiles to restore the illusion of a colorful cube. Choose from eight puzzle sizes, ranging from 12 to 243 tiles, and race against the clock to beat your personal best. Simple rules, precise controls, endless challenges.

apps.name: Pyreroad
apps.short_description: Two houses, one crown, and one road to each keep. Shape a maze of siege engines to hold your causeway, then muster horse, rams and dragons to break your rival's. Every coin spent on walls starves your march. A real-time duel against five bot tiers or live rivals online.

apps.name: Rally Panic with the BRO!
apps.short_description: Don't let your buddy kill you! :)) 2-player co-op panic asymmetrical game. Team up with up to 8 players in 4 cars for chaotic co-op rallying. Dodge wildlife, wipe mud off the windshield, and trust your navigator’s directions. Paint your car, buckle up, and try to keep the friendship on the road.

apps.name: Rasek
apps.short_description: Experience the glory and adventure of old-school online RPGs in this pixel art action MMORPG. Choose your class, customize your skills, battle with a clan or travel alone, play your way and fight to become a legend in Rasek.

apps.name: REAL GO - Custom Go
apps.short_description: Light Go that opens straight to the board. Play Go against an AI that plays like a real person of your rank, from 20 kyu to 9 dan. Ask for advice and see live position analysis mid-game, solve 1,800+ classic tsumego, and pick from 13 boards and 39 stone sets in 3D or 2D. From beginner to pro.

apps.name: RECURSE.D
apps.short_description: RECURSE.D is a dark-fantasy first-person action RPG. Set out from the Old Port, raid ruined castles and fight your way back with what you carry. Lead hired companions and shape your build with equipment, spells and techniques.

apps.name: Redneck Redemption
apps.short_description: 100% authentic redneck alien hunting simulator. Drink, fight, stalk and piss your way through an alien invasion.

apps.name: Remnant Protocol
apps.short_description: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

apps.name: Rolling Cheese
apps.short_description: Chase a runaway wheel of ridiculously delicious as hell cheese with a worm inside!!! Slap the cow, use bombs and other absurd items to get the cheese. Play solo or turn every chase into complete chaos with others to see if you can grab the most delicious cheese in the world!!!

apps.name: Rotor City
apps.short_description: Fly a helicopter over five living cities. Fight fires with a bucket, fly medevacs, winch skiers off mountains and land on oil rigs at night. Build your base, grow a fleet of 14 helicopters, and watch the fuel. A calm, unhurried helicopter game made by a real pilot.

apps.name: Rune Summoners
apps.short_description: A free-to-play strategic fantasy card battler. Summon souls, cast spells and unleash Twin-Star summons. Challenge 10 summoners with their own themed decks, and create original cards with your own art and voice.

apps.name: Salt of the Earth
apps.short_description: An isometric medieval city builder. Grow one manor from a few hovels into a market town. Houses upgrade when the families in them get the food, water and services they need. Stock up before winter, when nothing grows. Later, raiders come to set the town on fire, and you build towers to stop them.

apps.name: Saturation
apps.short_description: Saturation is a short horror game where you work as a saturation diver and deep sea welder. After six months at the bottom of the ocean, your shift is coming to an end, but so are your nerves...

apps.name: SCARBOUND
apps.short_description: A roguelite survival action game where wounds never heal. Mow down hordes with auto-attacks, read the map to choose which fights to take and which rewards to chase, and sign contracts for power at a price. HP carries over and healing is scarce, so one wound can change the whole journey.

apps.name: Schnuffels Hexa-World - You got schnuffeld
apps.short_description: Seven fluffy Schnuffels, a mysterious hexagonal world, and plenty of puzzling challenges! Match colorful hex tiles, explore magical chambers, collect special fruits, and discover seven hidden keys. A charming puzzle adventure full of surprises!

apps.name: Second Saga
apps.short_description: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.

apps.name: Secret 3-Cushion Club
apps.short_description: Welcome to a secret members-only billiards club where 20 beautiful heroines await! Face them in thrilling three-cushion matches and enjoy their intimate service as your prize. Adult videos, a story and a free practice mode! A sweet, breathtaking time for special members only begins.

apps.name: Secrets Within Us
apps.short_description: A PS1-style survival horror game focused on exploration, resource management, and navigating connected areas while avoiding and surviving hostile threats. Follow Evan Rowe as he searches for answers about a friends secrets.

apps.name: Seduction Clicker
apps.short_description: An adult clicker, Idle and Incremental game where each click unlocks more provocative poses, nudes, and explicit scenes. Progressively reveal sultry visuals, from teasing poses to intimate moments, with endless rewards that will keep you coming back for more!

apps.name: See Through Static: The Collection
apps.short_description: SEE THROUGH STATIC: THE COLLECTION contains 4 First-Person Psychological Horror Games. Each showcasing new perspectives, mechanics, and insight into the overall story. Search through cryptic tapes and radio frequencies. Examine bodies and report your findings. Can you uncover the truth in time?

apps.name: Senti Metrica
apps.short_description:
“If you are not loved, you won’t survive—”

A girl slowly turning into a monster,
and the “Metrica” who hunt her.

A survival otome game
where you waver between reason and instinct.

apps.name: Shadows Of Deceit
apps.short_description:
Shadows of Deceit is a first-person psychological horror focused on narrative investigation and atmosphere.
Set within an abandoned building deep in Havenbrook forest, the player uncovers fragments of the past and reconstructs the truth about the night Isabelle Nox disappeared.

apps.name: Shellcrushers
apps.short_description: Shellcrushers is a stylized horde tower defense game: tens of thousands of roaches pour in at once, and you meet them with six turrets, RPG-deep upgrade trees and procedurally generated maps, so no two fights play the same.

apps.name: Sinking Hole
apps.short_description: You voluntereed to work on the maintenance of a shaft capsule that descends into an unknown hole. You will have to manage your time to the best of your abilities to ensure you ever reach the bottom, if there is one. The thing we fear is unknown, although the unknown seems to know you...

apps.name: SNOWBALLZ
apps.short_description: SNOWBALLZ is a wild online shooter where snowballs replace bullets! Pack snowballs, throw them, and take cover on snow-covered city streets. Deathmatch, TDM, and Capture the Flag — pure snowy chaos with friends!

apps.name: Sol One
apps.short_description: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

apps.name: Soldiers at War
apps.short_description: Command a squad of WWII soldiers in deep, turn-based isometric tactical combat. Pick your eight-man team from a persistent platoon, equip them with authentic historical weapons, and fight through covert missions from North Africa to Germany.

apps.name: Someone Else's Number
apps.short_description: Your new phone number used to belong to someone else. At 2:14 AM, a stranger still writes to it. A romance played entirely on your phone in 2011: make friends, fall for someone, and decide what to do with a secret that was never meant for you.

apps.name: Southbound Overkill
apps.short_description: Travel back to the Ice Age, where you hunt, craft, upgrade and survive, wondering how you got here, what your name is and what happened to the 45 contractors before you. Commit to the historical overkill, or stay slow and calculated to uncover the hidden secrets of the world.

apps.name: SPUM TD
apps.short_description: 'SPUM TD' is a 2D strategy game that combines Auto-Chess and Tower Defense. Hire units from a randomized shop and match element and class synergies to build a powerful formation. Fend off pouring waves of enemies and complete your ultimate lineup!

apps.name: Stampgram: Little Album
apps.short_description: Stampgram: Little Album blends relaxing nonogram puzzles with stamp collecting. Follow number clues, reveal pixel art, and fill your little album with charming stamps at your own pace.

apps.name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
apps.short_description: There's something exciting about staying at a business hotel. A room you've never seen, a night all to yourself. What will you do? Please relax and enjoy your stay with us.

apps.name: Stereosis
apps.short_description: A single-player 3D platformer rendered entirely as a real-time autostereogram: run, jump, and rotate the camera 90° while free-viewing the dot pattern to see the platforms hidden inside it.

apps.name: Store Crew Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a supermarket with up to 4 players in co-op! Unload deliveries, stock shelves, set your prices, hire staff and customize your store. Put out trash fires, chase off taggers. Automate your supermarket's entire supply chain.

apps.name: Strategy Core
apps.short_description: Lead your clan from a small settlement all the way to the launch of a colony ship. Gather resources, construct buildings, advance your technology, and defend against raids. Spanning seven eras, a procedurally generated world, and rival clans—in Strategy Core, your survival depends on your strategy.

apps.name: Street League Football
apps.short_description: Physics street football. Run routes, fight for catches, run up walls and lay people out. Play Route Battle 1 ON 1, 3 ON 3, Endless and 500 against the CPU, online on one shared field with up to 6 players across PC and phones, or 1 ON 1 on the couch with two controllers.

apps.name: Struggle of Empires
apps.short_description: The turn results are in! Struggle of Empires brings back the thrill of play-by-email empire games. Rule a fantasy realm, a steampunk power or a real people from 5000 BC to today: plot with friends and rivals, send your orders, then tear open your realm's own newspaper to see what happened.

apps.name: Su Nomine: Sassari 1349
apps.short_description: A narrative RPG set in Sassari in 1349. Explore a lost medieval city, gather information, and decide whom to trust, what to reveal, and what to hide. Your choices will shape the fate of an entire city.

apps.name: Sunflowers and the Goddess of Death
apps.short_description: A retro-inspired turn-based RPG of faith, loss, and rebellion. Overcome the designs of a dread goddess, liberate your people, and shatter the chains that bind you.

apps.name: SurviRail
apps.short_description: SurviRail is a game about exploration and managing your own space train. Expand your train cars, upgrade your engines, collect resources, and discover new locations in the unknown space.

apps.name: Sushi On Wheels
apps.short_description: Sushi On Wheels is a cozy management game where you run your dream sushi truck business in a Japanese setting inspired by the real life Izu Peninsula. Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals as you travel around Japan and complete your grandmother’s dream!

apps.name: Swarm Bunker: Harvest Factory
apps.short_description: Idle defense you can't lose meets conveyor-belt factory automation. Your bunker holds back an endless swarm, every kill drops raw materials into the warehouse, then belts haul them to production lines you design, turning bugs into ammo, lures and goods. More bugs, more resources, a bigger factory.

apps.name: Sweet Princess
apps.short_description: Sweet Princess - A simple and beautiful puzzle game themed around princesses. Spend wonderful time with five lovely princesses in different castles, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the princess's photos in the gallery.

apps.name: Sweetheart
apps.short_description: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.

apps.name: Sweetie's Motel
apps.short_description: A free co-op horror game for 1-4 players about exploring an endless motel, running from scary things, and collecting room service trays.

apps.name: System Critical 3
apps.short_description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for VR.

apps.name: s[TOR-Y]telling: Closed Loop
apps.short_description: Local AI writes your characters' replies in 26 languages and draws each scene on your own GPU, with no usage fees. Multi-character scenes, voice narration and idle storytelling, plus 52 built-in stories and a visual novel where the Loop is watching.

apps.name: TAN LINES
apps.short_description: An open-world summer on Barcelona's beaches with five beach girls, in bikinis or topless, your choice. Run, swim, sunbathe, race and get close to each of them. We're a tiny indie team building this every day. Wishlist and come along!

apps.name: Tapal
apps.short_description: Bring favorite characters to your desktop! Tapal AI pals remember, evolve, start chats and share selfies and videos. Import character cards and memories, then use Skills and MCP for PC tasks, immersive roleplay and life in other worlds with images and sound.

apps.name: TappyCat
apps.short_description: TappyCat is a cute pixel kitty who settles onto your desktop and turns work and study into a warm, cozy ritual. It's a desktop pet, a Pomodoro timer, and a smart productivity tracker all at once - all in one little cat.

apps.name: Terafom
apps.short_description: Land on a bright sea planet, bop cute slimes, grow land from the sea and build a city with your family. No PvP: a safe online world for the whole family.

apps.name: Terrible Forest Management
apps.short_description: In the age of drones and droids, Hose-Bots keep the forest from going up in smoke… until a rogue crew hacked half of them into flamethrowing Firebugs. Grab your friends, pick a side, and battle for the woods in chaotic 4v4 matches of hose versus flame!

apps.name: The Archives of Trevosa
apps.short_description: Decipher the secret history of Trevosa to discover the true heir to the throne. Investigate historical records, translate a mysterious language, and piece together the identities and relationships of a sprawling family tree in this engrossing deduction puzzle.

apps.name: The Breaking Room
apps.short_description: Incremental game with physics destruction. Shatter increasingly large environments with your telekinetic abilities. Upgrade your biometrics and research powerful compounds to explore the depths of the breaking room.

apps.name: The Dark Signal
apps.short_description: The Dark Signal is a gothic roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a transmission. Build a deadly deck, command summons, manage Debt and Fury, uncover forbidden signals, and survive three floors before facing the entity known as The Last Hand.

apps.name: The Gastarbeiters
apps.short_description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Build a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

apps.name: The Hero is too Powerful so let's Pleeease Settle this Peacefully!
apps.short_description: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

apps.name: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
apps.short_description: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

apps.name: The Last Duck
apps.short_description: The Last Duck is a top-down roguelite shooter where you play as a rebellious duck battling hordes of farm animals. Wield up to 6 weapons, collect powerful items, create unique builds, and fight your way through the farm and into the wild!

apps.name: The White Light
apps.short_description: The White Light broke, and its shards fell into six cursed worlds. Go down after them in a dark co-op roguelike for 1-4 hunters: carve through hordes, fight bosses that strike on the beat and build your hunter from 300 cards. Stay together. Alone, the dark will eat you.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms: Cao Cao's Chastity Defense
apps.short_description: Cao Cao journeys across the realm, pursued by countless beauties eager to have their way with him. But he has eyes only for the married beauties of the Three Kingdoms... Play as Cao Cao in this absurd yet strangely logical adult game of romancing married women × defending his chastity.

apps.name: Tibula
apps.short_description: A top-down 3D fantasy MMORPG. Rise from the temple's well as a summoned soul and fight beside other players through the lands and fields of Tibula, a land where the ruins of forgotten kingdoms outnumber the living cities.

apps.name: TideLight
apps.short_description: Spend the summer with Nana June on Gull Island: fish the pond, the brook and the sea, fix up Grandpa's old boat and light the lighthouse again. Then come back five summers later and sail an archipelago of nine islands to relight their tidelights, one keeper and one fishy problem at a time.

apps.name: Timopet
apps.short_description:
Register your to-dos as quests and focus with a timer. Cute desktop pets keep you company right on your screen!
Complete a quest and your pets will give you coins as a gift! 
Open boxes with the coins you collect and gather all kinds of pets.

apps.name: TohKago
apps.short_description:
Throw it, aim it. Watermelon?—BOOM!
A fresh take on a staple of Japanese school sports days. The rules are simple: Pick up fruits and throw them into your team's basket. In a chaotic free-for-all, a single watermelon can make all your steadily collected fruits go BOOM. Who will have the last laugh?

apps.name: Touhou Hikouroku ~ Flight Risk
apps.short_description: Marisa fires her Master Spark and the recoil sends her flying. Blast your way around the great library, steal the books, and watch Patchouli's bill grow.

apps.name: Type Me Home
apps.short_description: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

apps.name: TypeCaster
apps.short_description:
Be quick, be accurate, or be dead. 
Prepare your fingers for a potentially chaotic action adventure, as you face epic boss battles in this Type 'em up/action RPG.

apps.name: Underbloom
apps.short_description: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.

apps.name: Viking Nest
apps.short_description: Create by decorating the North, once torn by war.

apps.name: Void Rhythm
apps.short_description:
Survive the siege in this high-octane top-down shooter. 
Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies and use Bullet Time to slow the chaos and dismantle the swarm. 
You can’t play it safe. Stay aggressive if you want to survive. In this place, an aggressive offense is your only defense.

apps.name: Voyage of the Damned
apps.short_description: A turn-based narrative survival voyage, 1904–05. Pile coal on the decks and you'll reach Dakar even if the colliers don't come. But the ships get slower and the men suffer for it. Decisions like this fill 224 days, from the Baltic to Tsushima.

apps.name: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria
apps.short_description: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game of conquest and heroes. Capture cities, recruit armies from ten distinct factions, level up your units, and clash in fast one-on-one duels where the marching order you choose decides the battle.

apps.name: We Made Gods
apps.short_description: 2040. A rogue AI has seized the world's war factories. Lead human veterans, machine-fused soldiers or the AI itself in a real-time strategy game of three asymmetric factions, a story campaign, skirmish against the AI and online multiplayer.

apps.name: We Roll at Dawn
apps.short_description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

apps.name: WE'RE ALL IN!
apps.short_description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

apps.name: Whenster
apps.short_description: Who knows when what happened? Whenster is a timeline card game for friends: place movies, TV series, video games, inventions and historic events in the right order before the clock runs out. Host on Steam, and your friends join for free right in their browser.

apps.name: Wisp & Willow
apps.short_description: Use cards to build a garden in this cozy puzzle game. Each level has a different deck. Each card has different interactions with other cards. Discover them and decide what kind of garden you want to build for yourself.

apps.name: Wittle Misfits
apps.short_description: Wittle Misfits is a chaotic 4–6 player baby party game where one baby is secretly evil. Complete minigames, survive the daycare, and use voice chat to outwit your friends—before nap time turns deadly.

apps.name: Wizards of Elnia
apps.short_description: Build a five-spell loadout and outplay rival wizards in a free-to-play online arena for up to eight players. Aim your casts, dodge incoming magic, and combine 40+ spells across free-for-all, team battles, and Deathmatch.

apps.name: Wordtex
apps.short_description: A roguelike word game where every letter counts. Create huge words, stack rule-bending upgrades, and unlock permanent items that change how you approach every run.

apps.name: Yehuelu Online
apps.short_description: Explore a fantasy MMORPG inspired by Chilean mythology. Battle legendary creatures, craft powerful gear, master professions, and uncover ancient secrets in a vast world full of adventure.

apps.name: Zeno Survivor
apps.short_description: A single-player survival RPG set in a beautiful yet dangerous post-apocalyptic world brought to life in 3D and pixel art.
