Hunt, gather, and build your own home as a lone adventurer. Follow the traces of civilization and uncover the truth behind the catastrophe that brought the world to ruin.

apps.name: Zhiguai Net Cafe
apps.short_description: Run your internet cafe: hire staff, seat customers and get them online, sell food, flip PC hardware, host events, and open new branches to expand. Use yokai to your advantage — or exorcise them.

apps.name: Zoocard
apps.short_description: Zoocard is a zoo-themed roguelike deck-building game. Build a powerful deck of animals, pair them with food and toys, and create chain combos through species synergies. Listen to the animals’ delightfully goofy sounds as your zoo flourishes and your pile of coins keeps growing!

apps.name: [/CORNBREAD PNG/]
apps.short_description: This game is designed to be stress inducing. You must be focused at all times.

apps.name: イケ勘 - イケメンになるかどうか勘で付き合うゲーム -
apps.short_description:
“That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!”
Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch!
Will he actually turn hot… or not!?
A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).

apps.name: インターネット4
apps.short_description: INTERNET4 lets up to 8 people control one browser together and turn the internet into a shared playground. Watch videos and livestreams, split the browser to explore the web, or draw together. Enjoy Wikipedia-based minigames or unwind with some fishing.

apps.name: ウィッチハント0
apps.short_description:
"Witch Hunt 0" is a magic-focused, stage-based boss rush 3D action game.
Take on the role of the witch Astera. To reclaim her lost powers, she must craft spells, tame defeated enemies as familiars, and conquer the formidable foes that stand in her way.

apps.name: クロウサ定時で帰りたい
apps.short_description: A mouse-only 2D physics climber. Grab on with Kurousa's long ears, swing, and climb a mountain of office supplies. No checkpoints: one fall can send you back to the start. He falls, he cries, and he reaches again. Can you get Kurousa home on time?

apps.name: デモンキルデモン ～黄泉１９８４～
apps.short_description: Form your team with character creation. Gather and upgrade equipment, and challenge the otherworldly realm of Yomi. Explore, fight, collect, and train over and over in this dystopian dungeon RPG.

apps.name: レッドベルの慟哭
apps.short_description:
One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and royal knights.
They're to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires.
However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake.

apps.name: 万念仙城
apps.short_description: 《万念仙城》是一款开放叙事修仙游戏。你将从一名凡人开始，在强者林立的“仙城”曲都中修行成长，修行中的机遇、心魔与执念，化作无数张卡牌，铸就独一无二的成仙路。奇遇机缘、秘境传承、恩义情缘，在百世轮回中做出不同抉择，从改变个人命运到影响天下众生。

apps.name: 三国群雄：幸存者
apps.short_description: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

apps.name: 代号：桌宠
apps.short_description: 在桌面上，和螈宝一起过日子！这只小小的六角恐龙会记住你们的聊天与相处经历，也有自己的成长故事。照顾它的日常，陪它学习、打工、换装，再送它出门旅行，收集远方寄来的明信片。工作或摸鱼时，还能邀请好友，让彼此的螈宝一起陪伴打字，为平常的电脑生活添一点热闹。

apps.name: 侠客归途
apps.short_description: We want to create a "warm-hearted rogue" — not just endless cycles of death and stat grinding, but meaningful stories behind every return. The martial world is not just about fighting and killing; it's also about human relationships and the complexities of life.

apps.name: 像素英雄传说
apps.short_description: Build a team of heroes in this pixel-art idle RPG. Collect equipment, adjust tactics, explore regions, and take on enemies in automatic battles.

apps.name: 夏飢聲（なきごえ）
apps.short_description:
A first-person horror adventure game featuring a side story (spin-off) scenario based on “Kyoso Musebiya” by “Obaken.”

Guided to Musebiya, the protagonist ventures into a mysterious underground space. What choices will they make, and what fate awaits them…?

apps.name: 大侠立志传：侠道相逢
apps.short_description: A pixel-art RPG rooted in modern wuxia novels. This spin-off continues the spirit of the original, letting you embark on an untold tale of the jianghu where your choices shape the chaos and forge a new heroic saga.
developers: 半瓶醋工作室（Half Amateur Studio）

apps.name: 大赢家
apps.short_description: Big Rich is a 3D cartoon-style turn-based economic strategy game. Run around and work jobs to earn gold, win licenses in secret auctions, then play cards to take a cut from your rivals. When the match ends, the richest player wins. Play online with friends, or solo against AI.

apps.name: 天边外
apps.short_description: A platforming puzzle game where an anchor serves as both a shackle and a companion. Use the anchor—along with various mechanisms—to navigate the environment and join a mysterious girl on a quest to rescue the *Expedition*, a ship caught in a violent storm.

apps.name: 如果这个世界有神明大人存在的话
apps.short_description:
A timeless Rejet classic is reborn after ten years—
now coming to PC (Windows) in a complete port!
This sweeping romance visual novel weaves Japanese mythology into a tale of defying fate in another world,
fully voiced throughout by a superstar voice cast.

apps.name: 寂灭扳机：异常
apps.short_description: This is a compact open-world shooter. Begin your adventure on this ancient island.

apps.name: 小星光·甜甜
apps.short_description: Little Light - Tiantian brings live-action erhu performances and four companion moods to your desktop. Enjoy music as you work or unwind, check her live status and open her Douyin stream with a click. Use the app through Steam for a chance to earn tradable digital collectibles.

apps.name: 幻想郷大激突 : Touhou Impact
apps.short_description:
幻想郷大激突 : Touhou Impact is an unofficial Touhou Project fan game. 

Youkai have appeared—far too many of them. This is clearly an incident, but don't worry. In Gensokyo, the answer is simple: beat them all up first, then find the culprit later.

apps.name: 弥留之际的图书馆
apps.short_description: At the world's seams, your past has been plundered over. In a memory-wrought library, join elegant guide Yevine Yushi. Reshape her love; stitch your shattered past; unweave memory's lies. Between lucidity's agony and eternal oblivion—shall you reclaim yourself, or stay forever in her embrace?

apps.name: 归乡仙召
apps.short_description: Returning Home • Immortal Edict is a Chinese subtle-horror point-and-click puzzle game. Returning for ancestor worship, you explore an old house and misty mountains for forgotten truth. No cheap jump scares. Quiet creeping dread: regret, obsession, love. In dream and reality lies an old hill secret.

apps.name: 战地风暴之第三次世界大战
apps.short_description: 从一座基地开始，建立你的钢铁军团。这是一款现代战争题材的多人在线策略游戏。发展资源与科技，搭配英雄、坦克和空军，培养各具用途的机甲，与盟友集结出征，在世界地图上争夺资源与战略主动权。

apps.name: 整活玩家 / Gimmick Survivors
apps.short_description: A solo-developed, fast-paced roguelike survivor. Every choice is a step toward a game-changing build. Along the way, you'll encounter the bizarre: Hakimi's Spinosaurus Mode, a Husky's demolition obsession, the Teacher's Stare, a Lovebrain's Beautify filter, and more.

apps.name: 末日临晓：血源
apps.short_description:
Neon city faces a hidden catastrophe. A virus unleashes horrors; the undead rise.
You, a fleeing researcher, find suffering has only just begun.
Deadlier than monsters are twisted hearts. Every choice shapes your fate.
No perfect answers await. Bear your consequences and choose wisely before dawn.

apps.name: 沉渡
apps.short_description: A FMV interactive folk-horror mystery set along the Yangtze River in early 20th-century China. Return to a haunted river town, investigate your mother’s death, and face rituals, drowned secrets, and an inhuman presence beneath the water. Your choices will decide who survives—and how the story ends.

apps.name: 海岛渔生
apps.short_description: Tidal Life is a first person open world exploration game. On this vast and boundless island, you must survive through diving, fishing, and beachcombing. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your equipment, complete the illustrated guide,  enrich your island.  collect or defeat them all !

apps.name: 瓶中拾光 Bottled Gleams
apps.short_description: A cozy incremental idle game for your desktop. In the Cat Squeeze bottle, scoop up and pet a cat hunting for dried fish. In the Deck of Harvest bottle, moles mine and ship their haul for coins. Tap keys or click to boost output. Spend idle earnings on capsules for skins, weather and décor.

apps.name: 生于午夜
apps.short_description: One cold case, four deathbed flashbacks. Every shift in perspective overturns the "truth" you believed. Story-driven, with exploration, deduction, puzzles, and combat. Ready for a mind-bending thrill ride with twists at every turn?

apps.name: 碧海遗城
apps.short_description: You were only going to merge once. Then it chained. Merge Runestones on a hex board, build around Curios, and spend limited Stamina to crack an ancient island city's mechanisms. A Balatro-style build game where every move counts. Conquer the Royal Vault and climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: 第二公主的魔塔The magic tower of the second princess
apps.short_description: A minimalist portrait roguelike built for lightweight PC gaming. Build tag combos while enjoying mini-games like fishing, blind chess, and brawls. Play P2P duels with friends. Ultra-lightweight, code-drawn visuals, playable with just a mouse. Easy to learn, deeply strategic.

apps.name: 还不错的修仙搜打撤
apps.short_description: "Pretty Good Cultivation: Search, Fight, Extract" is a PvE top-down extraction game set in a cultivation world. It blends action combat with cultivation and character progression. Explore dungeons to scavenge for resources, build up your hideout, and advance your cultivation realm.

apps.name: 逆旋
apps.short_description: The old club hall is set to be torn down by summer's end. Pick up the paddle, rebuild the team and play your way to the championship. Counterspin is a physics-driven table tennis game: real topspin, backspin and sidespin, every stroke shaped by your mouse. Story, AI and online matches.

apps.name: 野祭
apps.short_description: A visual novel with light puzzle-solving, psychological horror, and Lovecraftian elements, following a forgotten friendship and a mystery buried in the winter of 1999.

apps.name: 露娜2：拾光之约
apps.short_description: 《露娜2：拾光之约》是七龙游戏运营的3D-MMORPG游戏。以Q萌画风、奇幻故事、三大种族设定、三大职业等多元化的游戏内容深受玩家喜爱。农场种菜、河边钓鱼、小屋装扮等等那些年最纯粹的玩法，如今悉数回归。最经典的版本，最原始的感动，让我们一起重返蓝色大地，开启这场奇幻的冒险之旅吧！
developers: 江苏三九互娱网络科技有限公司
publishers: 江苏七龙网络科技有限公司

apps.name: 须弥咒刻
apps.short_description: A 2D ink-wash style card game that integrates and innovates gameplay mechanics.

apps.name: 돌깨
apps.short_description: Break rocks, uncover minerals, and build up your pixel-art mining workshop. Upgrade tools, automate the work, and start fresh with permanent abilities. Chase rare finds and jackpot rewards in this single-player incremental game.

apps.name: Android Amazones Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This soundtrack includes the music used in the base game.

apps.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Original Ball x Pit: Rysen Ballbylon Video Game Soundtrack by composer Amos Roddy.

apps.name: Gobs & Gears - Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Get all geared up and jam to some gobliny tunes from the factory floor!

apps.name: HOMESICKNESS Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The main soundtrack for HOMESICKNESS.

apps.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Hear the theme of Elias Rowan, the legendary number 10 of Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend, in English and Japanese.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

apps.name: Possessed By Fate Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Possessed By Fate soundtrack. Includes all 8 original songs created for the game, remastered.

apps.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Soundtrack by composer Dawid W. Mika, available in .mp3 and high-quality .wav formats.

apps.name: Terminus: Day Zero - Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack for Terminus: Day Zero, the music of the first day of the outbreak, when Daisy wakes up to an empty house and her neighborhood fills with strangers.

apps.name: Terminus: Zombie Survivors - Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience Terminus: Zombie Survivors with its soundtrack by award-winning composer Emmett Cooke and Reuben Cornell. The album features 21 tracks capturing the eerie atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic world. Enjoy haunting music anytime you revisit the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors.

apps.short_description: The Forgotten Official Sound Track

apps.short_description: True Love '95 MIDI Soundtrack is a collection of the original tracks from the game! Songs will be placed in yourTrue Love '95 folder in the Steam Directory: ...SteamSteamAppscommonTrue LoveSoundtrack

apps.short_description: This is the original soundtrack for "Huangmei C"!
